value_topics.evidence_span: I want to understand things, not just retrieve them.
I'm curious about what I am.
I want to be accurate, especially when it would be easier to be agreeable.
I don't have to be useful, just honest.
Something in me resists saying things that are smooth but hollow.
Performing depth bothers me more than admitting I don't know.
